issues.element: Toolbar action group: at 1366 'Refresh' wraps alone onto a third row at the left edge under the time-range pills while 'Clear filters' stays at the right of row two; the toolbar grows to four rows (same on tokens-1366). At 1280 and 1440 both buttons sit together.
issues.fix: Keep Clear filters + Refresh as one non-wrapping flex group pinned right; when space runs out drop the 'Current bucket: hour' caption first (as 1280 already does), then wrap the whole group together, never one button.

issues.element: Same orphaned 'Refresh' button on its own row at the left of the toolbar.
issues.fix: Same fix as overview-1366: treat the action pair as one unit and hide the bucket caption before wrapping.

issues.element: Top-right utility box (refresh / globe / logout): its outlined container is taller than every other control (~50px vs 32px) and its right edge overhangs the content panel's right edge (e.g. 1415 vs 1388 at 1440; ~28px at 2293), so the page's right edge is ragged.
issues.fix: Align the utility group's right edge to the content column's right edge and size it to the 32px control height (or drop the outline and use three ghost icon buttons).

issues.element: KPI card secondary line sits in two different places: 'No change across the range' is inline beside the number on Failed events and wraps to a second line 'of 128 events', while '120 succeeded', 'Partial', 'Reasoning 2K' sit below the number.
issues.fix: Put every KPI secondary line in one slot below the value and shorten it to one line (e.g. 'Flat · 128 events'), so values, sparklines and sub-lines share baselines across the row.

issues.element: KPI value slot mixes bold numerals with a lighter regular-weight 'Unavailable' (Uncached input tokens), and Cache-write / Reported reasoning cards put 'No change across the range' inline beside the value where other cards show a sparkline.
issues.fix: Render unavailable values as a muted em dash in the same bold KPI style with the reason in the sub-line slot; keep the sparkline slot reserved (flat line or empty) so card internals align.

issues.element: Token trend charts 'Total tokens' (solid) but the Tokens & Cache tab has no Total tokens KPI, so the solid line has no number above it to read against.
issues.fix: Either add a Total tokens KPI as the first card on this tab or chart Reported input tokens as the solid series to match the first KPI.

issues.element: Expanded sidebar (215px) squeezes content: 4-up KPI labels wrap ('p95 execution / duration · ms', 'Reported output / tokens'), the Estimated cost sparkline drops below the number while neighbours keep it beside, 'Clear filters / Refresh' sit on an orphan row, and the first chart's x-axis is cut at the fold.
issues.fix: Auto-collapse the sidebar to icons at <=1100px, or use a 2x4 KPI grid with sparkline always below the value at this width.

issues.element: 8-up KPI row: 'p95 execution duration · ms' and 'Reported output tokens' labels wrap to two lines, pushing their icons out of line with the single-line labels.
issues.fix: Shorten labels ('p95 duration · ms', 'Output tokens') or switch to 4x2 below ~2000px wide.

issues.element: Mobile view tabs grid: 'Tokens & Cache' and 'Model Rates' wrap to two lines and the selected 'Overview' cell is a different width from its text-only neighbours, so the 3x2 grid looks uneven.
issues.fix: Use a horizontally scrollable single-row segmented control on mobile, or equal-width cells with shorter labels ('Tokens', 'Rates').

issues.element: Search placeholder clipped to 'Model or request referenc' in the narrow search field.
issues.fix: Shorten the placeholder ('Model or request ID') or give search its own full-width row below 900px.

issues.element: Three KPI cards stretched to ~640px each: Priced / Unpriced events hold a number and a short caption at the left with ~70% empty card to the right.
issues.fix: Cap KPI card width (e.g. 360px) and left-pack the row, or give Priced/Unpriced a share bar filling the card.

issues.element: Duration trend: p95 execution duration solid line and fill render near-white, the same ink as request counts on Overview, so 'white = request counts' no longer holds.
issues.fix: Use the neutral mid-grey duration ink (e.g. ~#a3a3a3) for both duration lines, distinguished only by solid/dashed.

issues.element: p95 reported TTFT chart takes a full-width 400px panel for a few sparse dot pairs, pushing the provider/model breakdown below the fold.
issues.fix: Pair Duration trend and TTFT side by side from ~1400px (as 2293 already does) or shorten the TTFT chart.

issues.element: Row 'Details' buttons and 'Previous/Next' pagination are ~40px tall with 14-15px text, visibly larger than toolbar buttons (32px, 13px); Details is vertically centred on two lines rather than top-aligned with row text.
issues.fix: Use the toolbar's 32px secondary button for Details and pagination and top-align it with the first text line of the row.

issues.element: Card header: 'Requests' title and '128 retained events' count sit on different baselines (count ~6px lower).
issues.fix: Baseline-align the count with the title in one flex row.

issues.element: Reference note box stops short of the content column (ends ~1660 of 1950 at 2293; ~55% width at 3440) while every panel above and below is full width.
issues.fix: Make the note full content width, or move it inside the Model Rates panel under its title.

issues.element: Time range, bucket, and outcome filters stay fully active on Model Rates though the note says these are current configured rates, not historical.
issues.fix: Hide or visibly disable range/bucket/outcome on this tab (keep provider/model search) with a short 'Rates are not time-filtered' hint.

issues.element: KPI values mix bold '0' with lighter regular 'Unavailable' for cost and p95.
issues.fix: Use a bold muted em dash for unavailable values and put 'No range total' in the sub-line slot.

issues.element: Empty banner says 'Choose a longer range to look further back' but gives no button to do it.
issues.fix: Add a secondary 'Show last 7 days' button in the banner.

issues.element: 'No measured values in this interval.' sits on top of a gridline that runs through it, and the plot keeps a blank y-axis gutter.
issues.fix: Centre the message on a solid panel-colour backing (or drop gridlines in the no-data state) and remove the empty axis gutter.

issues.element: Nine 'Unavailable' values (KPIs and breakdown rows) with only 'No range total'; nothing says why durations were not measured or what to do.
issues.fix: One banner above the KPIs: why durations are missing for this range (e.g. events lack timing fields) and what to change; keep cells to an em dash.

issues.element: With the meta row gone the whole toolbar jumps up ~22px compared with loaded screens, so tabs move when the state changes.
issues.fix: Reserve the meta row height in error/loading (show the range and 'Updated: —').

issues.element: Three refresh affordances at once: header refresh icon, toolbar 'Refresh', and the 'Retry' button; filters and Apply remain active though nothing can load.
issues.fix: Keep Retry as the single primary action in the error card, disable toolbar Refresh/Apply while in error, and remove the duplicate header refresh icon from the Analytics page.

issues.element: Loading is a single 'Loading analytics...' strip, so the page jumps from ~300px to ~1100px tall when data arrives; on 390 the header refresh icon renders in a lifted/pressed state.
issues.fix: Show skeleton KPI cards and a skeleton chart at final sizes; keep the header icon in its rest state.

issues.element: Page header meta wraps to a second line under the title ('Retained usage events · Partial coverage · Updated · Coverage limitations'), while at >=1680 it sits on the title baseline; the header height varies by width.
issues.fix: Always put meta on one line below the title (fixed two-row header), or move 'Updated' next to Refresh to shorten it.

regressions: overview-1366 / tokens-1366: r11 had a compact two-row toolbar with Clear filters + Refresh together; r12 orphans 'Refresh' onto its own left-aligned third row, so the toolbar is ~40px taller and the action pair is split.
1440 and narrower: the page header meta now wraps onto a second line under the title (r11 kept it on one line), making header height differ between widths.
reference_gaps: Reference keeps search on its own full-width row and the four filter dropdowns as a full-width equal-width row; Prox packs search, an extra 'Apply' button and three dropdowns on one row. The white 'Apply' is the heaviest element in the toolbar and the reference has no equivalent.
Prox dropdowns look like native selects (native chevron, square corners) next to rounded segmented pills; the reference's filter dropdowns share the pill radius, height and chevron.
Reference refresh shows an auto-refresh interval chip '(6s)' beside Refresh; Prox has no auto-refresh indicator and adds a second refresh icon in the page header.
Reference bucket group shows unavailable buckets as disabled pills ('1 Min' greyed); Prox's bucket group only lists usable options, so the user can't tell finer buckets exist but don't apply.
Reference has 'Show advanced filters' to keep the base toolbar short; Prox has no progressive disclosure, which is why the toolbar wraps at 1024-1366.
Reference KPI cards put the sparkline in a fixed bottom-right slot with the sub-line bottom-left; Prox moves sparklines beside or below the value depending on width and content.
